title: Figure 16: Evolution of Ultracapacitors (2010-2050 timeline with product images)
description: Timeline infographic with columns for 2010, 2020, 2030 and 2050 and blue arrows showing miniaturization over time. The 'ULTRACAPS' row shows a large cylindrical Maxwell ultracapacitor shrinking to small chips; additional rows show product photos progressing from a laptop to a tablet to a small device, and from a large rack battery pack to smaller packaged modules. Caption reads 'Figure 16. Evolution of Ultracapacitors'.
